reason: Documentation correction, internal only. Runbook section 3b claimed the per-platform event-age metric carries no Signal series at all. That was wrong and was measured wrongly: Signal emitted continuously over the retention window and is absent only after a restart until the first envelope arrives, because a None age is skipped and Prometheus creates a labelled series on first observation. Same lazy-series effect that hides the gate's go counter. Corrected in place with the reading that disproves it. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
